rows.label: David
rows.known_for: shepherd boy who slew a giant
rows.description: king of Israel and Judah
rows.hook: is credited with writing many psalms and with making Jerusalem his capital

rows.label: Moses
rows.known_for: led the Exodus out of Egypt
rows.description: Abrahamic prophet said to have led the Israelites out of Egypt
rows.hook: led his people out of slavery and received the Ten Commandments on a mountain

rows.label: Solomon
rows.known_for: wise king who built the Temple
rows.description: king of Israel and son of David
rows.hook: is remembered for his wisdom, including a famous ruling over two women and a baby

rows.label: Abraham
rows.known_for: ready to sacrifice his only son
rows.description: foundational legendary figure among adherents of the eponymous Abrahamic religions
rows.hook: is honored as the father of many nations and was tested by a command to offer up his son

rows.label: Mary
rows.description: mother of Jesus Christ
rows.hook: is honored in the Hail prayer and visited by an angel with surprising news

rows.label: Judas Iscariot
rows.description: notable as betrayer of Jesus, one of Jesus's original twelve disciples
rows.hook: is remembered as the disciple who handed his teacher over to the authorities with a kiss

rows.label: John the Baptist
rows.description: 1st-century Jewish itinerant preacher (Bible)
rows.hook: was a desert preacher in camel hair who baptized people in the river

rows.label: John the Apostle
rows.description: apostle of Jesus; son of Zebedee and Salome, brother of James; traditionally identified with John the Evangelist, John of Patmos, and the Beloved Disciple
rows.hook: is traditionally credited with a Gospel and the final book of the New Testament

rows.label: Methuselah
rows.known_for: the oldest man in the Bible
rows.description: oldest person in the Bible, Biblical Patriarch
rows.hook: is said to have lived 969 years, a record in his book

rows.label: Jacob
rows.known_for: wrestled an angel, father of twelve tribes
rows.description: in Genesis, a son of Isaac, also known as Israel; the patriarch of the Israelites
rows.hook: was renamed after a night-long struggle and had a famous dream about a ladder to heaven

rows.label: Queen of Sheba
rows.description: biblical figure
rows.hook: traveled with gifts to test a wise king with hard riddles

rows.label: Esau
rows.description: in Genesis, the older son of Isaac and the brother of Jacob
rows.hook: was a hairy hunter who lost his inheritance to a smooth-skinned twin

rows.label: Enoch
rows.known_for: walked with God, taken without dying
rows.description: biblical figure, son of Jared
rows.hook: is the great-grandfather of a famous flood survivor and is said to have vanished from earth

rows.label: Noah
rows.description: biblical prophet, son of Lamech, major figure in the Book of Genesis
rows.hook: was told to gather pairs of animals before the rains came and later saw a rainbow

rows.label: Saint Joseph
rows.description: Christian saint; husband of Mary and father of Jesus
rows.hook: is the quiet patron saint of workers, guided by dreams in the Nativity story

rows.label: Matthew the Apostle
rows.description: Christian evangelist and apostle (10-74)
rows.hook: left a tax booth to follow Jesus and is credited with the first Gospel

rows.label: Ishmael
rows.description: son of Abraham in the Hebrew bible, prophet in Islam
rows.hook: was the first son of his famous father, sent away into the desert with his mother

rows.label: Samson
rows.description: judge of ancient Israel, known for wielding supernatural strength (Judges)
rows.hook: was a mighty judge whose strength vanished when his hair was cut

rows.label: Joseph
rows.known_for: sold into Egypt, coat of many colours
rows.description: Biblical figure, son of Jacob and Rachel and governor of Egypt during the late Hyksos dynasty
rows.hook: was a dreamer thrown into a pit by his brothers, who later interpreted Pharaoh's dreams

rows.label: Elijah
rows.known_for: prophet taken up in a chariot of fire
rows.description: Biblical prophet
rows.hook: challenged priests of Baal on a mountain and rode a whirlwind to heaven

rows.label: St. James the Elder
rows.description: one of the Twelve Apostles of Jesus
rows.hook: was one of the first apostles called by Jesus and is patron of the pilgrimage to Compostela

rows.label: Adam
rows.description: first man according to the Abrahamic creation and religions such as Judaism, Christianity and Islam
rows.hook: was formed from dust and lived in a garden until he ate forbidden fruit

rows.label: Thomas the Apostle
rows.description: one of the Twelve Apostles in the New Testament
rows.hook: demanded to touch the wounds before believing in the resurrection

rows.label: Lazarus of Bethany
rows.known_for: raised from the dead by Jesus
rows.description: subject of a prominent miracle of Jesus in the Gospel of John
rows.hook: was a friend of the Messiah whose sisters were Martha and Mary, and whose tomb was opened after four days

rows.label: Joshua
rows.description: figure in the Torah, successor of Moses
rows.hook: succeeded the lawgiver and brought down city walls with trumpets

rows.label: Goliath
rows.known_for: giant slain by a shepherd boy
rows.description: giant Philistine warrior
rows.hook: was a huge Philistine champion who terrified an army until a boy with a sling stepped up

rows.label: Isaac
rows.description: Biblical character; son of Abraham
rows.hook: was the son born to elderly parents and spared by an angel at the altar

rows.label: Isaiah
rows.description: biblical character
rows.hook: foretold a child called Immanuel and saw a vision of seraphim with burning coals

rows.label: Saul
rows.description: first king of the United Kingdom of Israel
rows.hook: was anointed as the first monarch of his people but fell out of favor with God

rows.label: Daniel
rows.description: biblical figure associated to the Book of Daniel
rows.hook: was thrown to hungry beasts for praying but came out unharmed

rows.label: Nicodemus
rows.known_for: Pharisee who visited Jesus by night
rows.description: Pharisee, biblical figure appearing in the Gospel of John
rows.hook: was a religious leader who asked the Messiah about being born again and later helped bury him

rows.label: Sarah
rows.description: biblical matriarch, prophet, and major figure in Abrahamic religions
rows.hook: laughed when told she would have a child in her nineties

rows.label: Seth
rows.description: biblical figure, third son of Adam
rows.hook: was the son born after the first murder, taking the place of a slain brother

rows.label: Andrew the Apostle
rows.description: religious figure of the Christian faith
rows.hook: was the first disciple called by the Messiah and later introduced a sibling to him

rows.label: Jonah
rows.description: Biblical and Quranic prophet
rows.hook: fled a mission to Nineveh and spent three days inside a sea creature

rows.label: Esther
rows.known_for: Jewish queen of Persia who saved her people
rows.description: Biblical Jewish queen of Persia and Medes (Book of Esther)
rows.hook: won a Persian king's favor and risked her life to stop a plot, celebrated at Purim

rows.label: Ezekiel
rows.known_for: prophet of the valley of dry bones
rows.description: biblical prophet and main figure of the Book of Ezekiel
rows.hook: saw wheels within wheels and a vision of a chariot throne during exile

rows.label: Aaron
rows.description: male human biblical and quranic figure, brother of Moses
rows.hook: spoke for a stammering sibling and made a golden calf in the desert

rows.label: Jeremiah
rows.description: biblical character; prophet
rows.hook: wrote Lamentations and warned of Jerusalem's fall

rows.label: Job
rows.description: biblical figure
rows.hook: lost family, wealth and health in a famous test of patience

rows.label: Samuel
rows.known_for: prophet who anointed Saul and David
rows.description: Biblical prophet and main figure of the First Book of Samuel
rows.hook: heard a voice calling in the night as a boy and later chose the first two kings

rows.label: Eve
rows.description: the first woman in the story of Genesis
rows.hook: was tempted by a serpent in the garden of paradise

rows.label: Hagar
rows.description: biblical character, Egyptian handmaid of Sarah, wife of Abraham
rows.hook: was an Egyptian maid cast into the wilderness, where an angel found her at a spring

rows.label: Absalom
rows.description: biblical character; third son of David (Second Book of Samuel)
rows.hook: was a handsome prince who rebelled against his father and got caught by his long hair

rows.label: Lot
rows.known_for: fled Sodom, his wife turned to salt
rows.description: Biblical and Quranic figure who had incestual daughters
rows.hook: escaped a doomed city of fire and brimstone while a loved one glanced back

rows.label: Shem
rows.description: Biblical figure, son of Noah, ancestor of the Semites
rows.hook: rode out a flood on a huge boat and is traditionally the ancestor of Middle Eastern peoples

rows.label: Gideon
rows.known_for: judge who won with three hundred men
rows.description: Judge in the Biblical Book of Judges
rows.hook: tested God with a fleece of wool, then won a battle using trumpets and torches in jars

rows.label: Rachel
rows.description: Biblical matriarch
rows.hook: was the younger bride a man worked fourteen years to marry

rows.label: Rebecca
rows.description: Biblical matriarch, wife of Isaac
rows.hook: was chosen as a bride at a well after offering water to camels

rows.label: Japheth
rows.description: Biblical figure, son of Noah
rows.hook: rode out a flood on a huge boat and is traditionally the ancestor of peoples to the north and west

rows.label: Deborah
rows.known_for: judge and prophetess who led Israel to victory
rows.description: fourth judge of Israel
rows.hook: held court under a palm tree and led a battle alongside a general named Barak

rows.label: Miriam
rows.description: sister of Moses and Aaron
rows.hook: watched over her baby brother in a basket on the river and later led a song of victory
